note: v57.19 — The percentile column is called 백분위 (P1464).

p.title: The percentile column is called 백분위
p.symptom: The rank column was headed 상대 점수 and showed 100 for the top rows, which read as a perfect score.
p.root_cause: The header kept the pre-P1419 score wording after the value became a percentile among passing rows.
p.fix: The column, the Why chain and the overlap note say 백분위; the cell tooltip explains that 100 means the top, not a perfect score or a probability.
p.violated_rule: Takeover review of v57.18 (2026-10-04): a number must state what it was computed on, a validation claim must be about the model actually on screen, and a gate is fixed by making the producer state its evidence — never by skipping the records it rejects.
p.verification: Local screener: header 백분위, tooltip on the rank cell.

changelog: **'상대 점수' → '백분위' (P1464):** 순위 열이 만점처럼 읽히던 '상대 점수 100'을 '백분위'로 바꾸고, 100은 맨 위라는 뜻일 뿐임을 표시합니다.
